title: Do Multi-Agents Dream of Electric Screens? Achieving 100% on AndroidWorld Through Task Decomposition
why: Replacement v2 of Minitap: Android UI-control agents, now with held-out AndroidWorld seeds, real Pixel 7 phones, and MobileMiniWoB++.
mechanism: Version update; still a multi-agent system for Android UI control, now also reporting held-out AndroidWorld instances, real Pixel 7 phones, and MobileMiniWoB++.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 116 AndroidWorld tasks on Minitap cloud emulators, real Pixel 7 phones, and the stock emulator; three pre-registered held-out seeds with pass@3, pass^3, and mean success plus confidence intervals; an ablation of decomposition vs deterministic mechanisms; a second, previously unused MobileMiniWoB++ benchmark. Collector assigned no scores.
evidence_locator: Wednesday 18 Nov 2026 cs.AI replacement listing; abs dateline last revised 16 Nov 2026 (this version, v2; history 1,002 KB vs v1 5,935 KB). Title changed (Perfect Accuracy → 100%). Abstract substantially rewritten vs corpus v1.
